title: Fix all in unit
summary: Applies autofixes for every fixable finding in the current unit, starting from the Structure form
intro: Read this when one unit has several auto-fixable findings and you want them all fixed at once. In the Structure form right-click the Diagnostics root or a finding and choose Fix all in unit; the caption shows how many fixes are available, and the item is disabled when there are none.

surfaces.caption: Fix all in unit
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Choose Fix all in unit; its caption shows how many fixes are available

questions.ask: How do I fix all auto-fixable findings in one unit at once?
